description: This file defines the URL class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, providing URL parsing, encoding, decoding, and key-value handling functionalities. It includes URL components such as scheme, host, port, path, query, and reference, along with methods for managing and validating URLs.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: Represents a URL with parsing, validation, and encoding functionalities, supporting components like scheme, host, port, path, query, and reference.

classes.name: URL::KeyValue
classes.description: Handles key-value pairs within URL query strings, providing methods to access, check existence, and convert values.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Returns the full URL as a string.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the URL has a valid scheme.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the URL components to default/empty states.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the scheme type of the URL.

methods.name: UserName
methods.description: Returns the username component of the URL.

methods.name: Password
methods.description: Returns the password component of the URL.

methods.name: Host
methods.description: Returns the host component of the URL.

methods.name: Port
methods.description: Returns the port number of the URL.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Returns the path component of the URL.

methods.name: Query
methods.description: Returns the query string of the URL.

methods.name: Ref
methods.description: Returns the reference fragment of the URL.

methods.name: UserName (setter)
methods.description: Sets the username component.

methods.name: Password (setter)
methods.description: Sets the password component.

methods.name: Host (setter)
methods.description: Sets the host component.

methods.name: Port (setter)
methods.description: Sets the port number.

methods.name: Path (setter)
methods.description: Sets the path component.

methods.name: Query (setter)
methods.description: Sets the query string.

methods.name: Ref (setter)
methods.description: Sets the reference fragment.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a string into URL-safe format.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string.

methods.name: Base64Encode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into Base64 string.

methods.name: Base64Decode
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string into binary data.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a URL string into components.

methods.name: ParseDomain
methods.description: Parses the domain part of a URL.
